scene: You step off the spiral lift into Pigeon Post Tower.
picture: A flat side-view slice of Pigeon Post Tower along one level wooden floor line. Far left stands the ornate brass spiral lift. Left, wooden lofts hold a grey pigeon clasping a letter. Centre, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands facing right. Right stands a red lever. Far right sits a twine-wrapped parcel.
shown: a plump grey pigeon perched on brass lofts on the left holding a letter
a tall red mechanical lever standing upright on the right
a large twine-wrapped parcel sitting unattended far right

variants.scene: The warm timber loft rustles with soft coos and whirring clockwork gears.
You arrive in the high rafters, still humming {tune} to yourself.
Cozy lantern light glows across wooden lofts filled with busy mail clerks.
